{"findings":[{"file":"sections/intro.tex","line_start":5,"line_end":6,"quote":"Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) platforms bill tenants per invocation and scale
each function down to zero instances when it is idle~\cite{jonas2019cloud}.","level":"paragraph","category":"topic-sentence","severity":"minor","problem":"The first sentence introduces billing and scale-to-zero but does not state p-1's local message that cold starts are frequent. That point appears only in the final sentence.","why":"The reader must reach the paragraph's end to learn the problem it is motivating.","json_ref":"p-1"},{"file":"sections/intro.tex","line_start":13,"line_end":14,"quote":"Providers mitigate cold starts with warm pools that keep recently used instances
alive for a fixed keep-alive window.","level":"paragraph","category":"topic-sentence","severity":"minor","problem":"The first sentence describes how warm pools work without stating p-2's local message that their memory-for-latency trade is poor for rarely invoked functions.","why":"The opening presents warm pools as a solution before revealing the limitation that gives this paragraph its argumentative purpose.","json_ref":"p-2"},{"file":"sections/intro.tex","line_start":19,"line_end":19,"quote":"Snapshot restore is the main alternative.","level":"paragraph","category":"topic-sentence","severity":"minor","problem":"The first sentence names an alternative without stating p-3's local message that snapshot restore skips initialization but is dominated by page faults. The limiting point arrives only in the final sentence.","why":"The reader cannot identify the paragraph's reason for ruling out this alternative from its opening.","json_ref":"p-3"},{"file":"sections/intro.tex","line_start":26,"line_end":26,"quote":"This paper makes two observations.","level":"paragraph","category":"topic-sentence","severity":"minor","problem":"The first sentence announces observations without stating p-4's local message about page sets making prefetching possible.","why":"The opening does not convey the insight that connects this paragraph to the preceding page-fault bottleneck.","json_ref":"p-4"},{"file":"sections/intro.tex","line_start":28,"line_end":29,"quote":"We build on both in \textsc{Prefetch} (Section~\ref{sec:method}) and evaluate it
in Section~\ref{sec:results}.","level":"paragraph","category":"off-message","severity":"major","problem":"This paragraph lists the two page-set observations but never explains how they enable prefetching or identifies what Prefetch does. Its roadmap therefore does not fulfill p-4's assigned function of stating the insight and contribution.","why":"The reader is left without the causal connection between the identified bottleneck and the paper's proposed solution.","json_ref":"p-4"}]}
